Today, we boast of extensive CTRM/ETRM expertise across softs, ags, fertilizers/chemicals, liquids, precious metals, concentrates, energy and much more. Quoreka is able to provide the industry with a very unique offering that meets the growing demands of commodity traders, energy merchants, miners, industrials to producers providing best-in-class functionality, user experience, technology and services. Our product roadmap is innovation-centric, focusing on AI and delivering strong product value propositions with clear short-term, medium-term, and long-term goals. Quoreka has over 200 employees and offices across the UK, India, Australia, Switzerland and Canada, serving :100 customers globally across multiple commodity segments. About the Role : Quoreka is expanding its support team in Adelaide, Australia and we are looking for a CTRM Support Engineer to provide front-line support for Quoreka's CTRM platform across our APAC customer base, helping clients keep their trading, physical operations and risk processes running with maximum possible uptime. As our clients' operations run around the clock, this role includes a 24/7 rotating on-call support roster alongside business-hours support. The role is based in our Adelaide office and works closely with Engineering, Product and Professional Services teams globally. Education : Engineering degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, from a recognized University. Required Skills & Experience: 3+ years' experience in application support, functional consulting or implementation of enterprise software, ideally CTRM/ETRM or ERP. Sound understanding of commodity trading business concepts: physical and derivative trades, contracts, logistics, pricing, settlements and risk. Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, and basic scripting skills. Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable with phone, email and in-person client interactions. Willingness and availability to participate in a 24/7 rotating on-call support roster, including after-hours, weekends and public holidays. A calm, customer-focused approach under pressure, and the ability to work independently and as part of a distributed, global team. Compliance with client Drug and Alcohol policies and other HSE/WHS requirements. Good to Haves : Hands-on experience supporting a CTRM/ETRM platform. Exposure to the agribusiness, mining or food and beverage commodity industries. Experience with ticketing/ITSM tools (e.g., Jira Service Management) in an SLA-driven support environment. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), APIs and integrations (REST, XML/JSON). Experience with automation tooling and deployment scripting. Key Responsibilities Customer Support Provide Tier 1 phone support for CTRM clients as part of a 24/7 rotating on-call roster, and handle email and ticketed support requests during business hours. Respond to and resolve support requests within the timeframes set out in client support agreements (SLAs). Log, record and categorise all support requests, and track each item through to completion. Build strong working relationships with client users, acting as a trusted local point of contact in the region.
